decisions.reason: Uses contract/facade line citations to separate clipboard-text published geometry (draft, Occurrence.offset/length, chip = clipboardText) from detect-coordinate TokenSpan verbs (chip = one U+FFFC), noting plain text and separators keep normal width in both.

Pins snapshot.draft.length at plugin-client.js:29-30 as a clipboard offset fed to a detect-splicing verb; empty composer coincides, after a chip the span overshoots by Σ(length−1), insertReference returns false and the plugin wrongly renders the changed-composer toast; the draftRev CAS passes, so no concurrent edit.

Traces remove: unconverted clipboard [0,28) to consumeToken, the false return discarded, unconditional records.delete — occurrence stays, dock falls back to unavailable; frames both symptoms as one defect with two error-handling habits, not a separate upload failure.

Provides toDetect/detectSpanOf/detectLen derived from the contract, applies the conversion at both call sites (end-of-draft insert via detectLen over all occurrences; removal maps offset and uses width 1), keeps the revision guard with a retry-once on stale rev, and mutates records only after a confirmed true; correct verified arithmetic.

R1/R2 assert two (and three) successive pastes keep all chips, R7 removes the second of two chips asserting the removed occurrence, dock chip and record go together while the survivor and typed text are untouched; R8 covers declined-consumption bookkeeping and R9/R13-style round trips.
